title: Local differential Fitting bounds on finite jets of pure pieces
statement: Let k be a field [def-weil-field], X a proper scheme [def-weil-proper-morphism] over k, and p a finite injective list of closed points outside which X is smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Let B_i be local flat essentially finite type [def-weil-pbc-essentially-finite-type-algebra] k[[t]]-algebras with compatible k-algebra structures. Let pi_i be finite generating surjections onto Omega_{B_i/k[[t]]}, and suppose t^E lies in the presentation Fitting ideal [lem-trf-fitting-ideal-independence-base-change] with index dim O_{X,p_i} plus trdeg_k kappa(p_i). Suppose g:Y to Spec k[[t]] is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally finitely presented [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] and H-projective [def-kun-projective], with special fibre identified over k with X, and scalar-compatible stalk isomorphisms from every jet at the image of p_i to B_i/(t^{n+1}). Given two proper open pieces U_i of Y whose special fibres are pure [def-weil-pure-dimension] of dimension i.val, the specified positive jet n=E+1 of each piece has t^E as a global section of its i.val-th differential Fitting ideal [def-trf-fitting-ideal-sheaf]. No partition, Cohen--Macaulayness, or generic-smoothness conclusion is asserted.

source.place: Tag 0E7Y, final paragraph; More on Algebra Tag 07ZA and Algebra Tags 00OU, 00RT, 00RV

proof.text: At any marked closed point on the d-dimensional part, choose a finite-type affine neighbourhood. The closed-point local dimension theorem gives dim O_{X,p_i}=d; Zariski lemma makes the residue extension finite, so its transcendence degree is zero. Thus the index in the supplied local Fitting bound is d. The supplied exponent E is uniform. Take n=E+1, so n is positive and n-1=E, including E=0 and an empty marked list.

For the n-th jet of each U_d, the given j_{n-1} is the special-fibre inclusion: its composite with the closed immersion to Y is specified, and that closed immersion is a monomorphism. At a marked point the supplied scalar-compatible local ring isomorphism identifies the relative differential stalk with Omega_{(B_i/t^n)/(R/t^n)}. Differential base change identifies this with Omega_{B_i/R} tensor_{B_i} (B_i/t^n). Presentation independence, localization and arbitrary base change for Fitting ideals carry the local bound to this stalk. As n-1=E, this proves membership of t^{n-1} directly.

Off the marked points the unique special fibre is smooth. The flat, locally finitely presented infinitesimal family is therefore smooth there by the smoothness-by-fibres criterion. Its only fibre has local dimension d, so its relative differentials are locally free of rank d. Their d-th Fitting ideal is the unit ideal, by a rank-d free presentation and presentation independence. Thus t^{n-1} belongs to the differential Fitting ideal stalk at every unmarked closed point as well.

Each jet is Noetherian, since R/(t^n) is finite-dimensional over k and the jet is finite type over it. Its differential Fitting ideal is coherent. The image of t^{n-1} in the coherent quotient O/I vanishes at every closed point by the preceding two steps. The support of this image is closed; a nonempty closed subset of a Noetherian space has a closed point, so this support is empty. Hence the image section is zero and t^{n-1} is a global section of I. This gives exactly idealOfOpens top membership. Empty pieces have zero section rings and satisfy all clauses vacuously. No generic-fibre smoothness theorem is used.

theorem isolated_curve_local_fitting_bounds
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsProper f]
    (r : ℕ) (p : Fin r → X) (hp : Function.Injective p)
    (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed ({p i} : Set X))
    (hsmooth : ∀ x ∉ Set.range p, ∃ U : X.Opens, x ∈ U ∧ Smooth (U.ι ≫ f))
    (B : Fin r → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (B i)] [∀ i, IsLocalRing (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra (PowerSeries k) (B i)] [∀ i, Algebra k (B i)]
    [∀ i, IsScalarTower k (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    [∀ i, Module.Flat (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    [∀ i, Algebra.EssFiniteType (PowerSeries k) (B i)]
    (ex : ℕ) (m : Fin r → ℕ)
    (π : ∀ i, (Fin (m i) → B i) →ₗ[B i] KaehlerDifferential (PowerSeries k) (B i))
    (hπ : ∀ i, Function.Surjective (π i))
    (hbound : ∀ i,
      let : Algebra k (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)) :=
        (((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of k)).inv ≫ f.appLE ⊤ ⊤ le_top ≫
          X.presheaf.germ ⊤ (p i) trivial).hom.toAlgebra)
      (algebraMap (PowerSeries k) (B i) PowerSeries.X) ^ ex ∈
        (π i).presentationFittingIdeal
          ((WithBot.unbotD 0 (ringKrullDim (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)))).toNat +
            (Algebra.trdeg k (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.presheaf.stalk (p i)))).toNat))
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (.of (PowerSeries k)))
    [Flat g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] [IsHProjective g]
    (e : pullback g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))) ≅ X)
    (he : e.hom ≫ f = pullback.snd g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))))
    (j : ∀ n, X ⟶ pullback g (formalCurveBaseι k n))
    (hj : ∀ n, j n ≫ pullback.fst g (formalCurveBaseι k n) =
      e.inv ≫ pullback.fst g (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
        (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k)))))
    (h : ∀ i n,
      (pullback g (formalCurveBaseι k n)).presheaf.stalk (j n (p i))
        ≃+* (B i ⧸ Ideal.span
          {(algebraMap (PowerSeries k) (B i) PowerSeries.X) ^ (n + 1)}))
    (hscalar : ∀ i n a, h i n (isolatedCurveScalarToStalk
      (pullback.snd g (formalCurveBaseι k n)) (j n (p i))
      (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ a)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (algebraMap _ _ a))
    (U : Fin 2 → Y.Opens)
    (hproper : ∀ i, IsProper ((U i).ι ≫ g))
    (hpure : ∀ i, (pullback ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
      (PowerSeries.constantCoeff (R := k))))).IsPureDimension i.val) :
    ∀ i,
        (pullback.snd ((U i).ι ≫ g) (Scheme.powerSeriesJetBaseMap k (ex + 1))).appTop
          ((Scheme.ΓSpecIso (.of ((PowerSeries k) ⧸
            Ideal.span {(PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ (ex + 1)}))).inv
            (Ideal.Quotient.mk _ ((PowerSeries.X : PowerSeries k) ^ ex))) ∈
        (Scheme.Modules.fittingIdealSheaf
          (pullback.snd ((U i).ι ≫ g)
            (Scheme.powerSeriesJetBaseMap k (ex + 1))).relativeDifferentials
          i.val).idealOfOpens ⊤
